subject: Marketplace listing — support hours, on-call routing & branding footnote
messages:
From: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@acmecloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing — support hours, on-call routing & branding footnote

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking this on. We're preparing the final marketplace submission for AcmeCloud and have a few items we need clarified from Redwood before we publish: 

1) Support SLA / hours — the listing currently shows 24x7 support. Can you confirm if Redwood will provide a true 24x7 on-call for marketplace customers, or if the public copy should indicate business-hours with on-call for critical incidents? We have internal procurement constraints that require clarity here.

2) On-call routing — if after-hours routing goes to a regional on-call partner, we need the exact failover description (e.g., Redwood on-call, then partner escalation to managed services).

3) Branding footnote — legal asked for a short footnote to accompany the marketplace badge that clarifies product naming vs. our branding (one-line). Can you provide preferred phrasing and any badge usage constraints?

Attached is our intake doc (Acme_Reqs_SLA.pdf) with the marketplace team's requirements. We're hoping to finalize copy by end of week to hit the Monday submission cutoff.

Can we do a 30-min sync tomorrow if that helps?

Best,
Ravi Shah
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
AcmeCloud

Attachment: Acme_Reqs_SLA.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — support hours, on-call routing & branding footnote

Hi Ravi — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kim (platform policy & listings) and Logan (customer ops) so we can answer each item precisely. Quick notes and a proposed approach below; we can lock copy on a call or via email.

Proposed approach (to meet your timeline):
- For the listing copy: present "Business hours support (M–F, 9am–6pm PT) with 24/7 critical-incident escalation" — that reflects our standard commercial boundary while allowing an explicit critical-incident path.
- On-call routing: provide a short flow that says: "First-line: Redwood support (regional queues). If incident is SEV1 after-hours, automatic escalation to Redwood on-call; if Redwood capacity constrained, failover to AcmeCloud-managed escalation (partner-managed) per agreed runbook." We can provide the exact runbook language if you need it for the portal.
- Branding footnote (one-line): suggested: "Redwood Inference is the provider of inference services; AcmeCloud is a reseller and marketplace partner. Product names on this listing reflect contractual branding between Redwood and AcmeCloud."  If legal prefers a shorter variant we can shorten to: "Service provided by Redwood Inference; sold via AcmeCloud marketplace."

I've attached our current brand guide excerpt (redwood-brand-guidelines-v2.pdf) with badge rules and logo clearance notes.

Available for a 30-min sync tomorrow at 11am PT — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-brand-guidelines-v2.pdf (PDF, 256 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — support hours, on-call routing & branding footnote

Ravi / team — following up with the operational specifics you asked for. Inline answers below (keeps your original numbering):

1) Support SLA / hours
- Public listing language we can commit to: "Business hours support (Mon–Fri, 9:00am–6:00pm PT) with 24/7 critical-incident escalation."
- Internal note: our commercial Dedicated/Private customers can contract full 24x7 handled support, but for marketplace listings where onboarding varies we default to the copy above. If AcmeCloud requires guaranteed 24x7 response SLAs in the listing, we'll need an SOW or a reserved capacity commitment and a separate pricing appendix.

2) On-call routing
- Recommended short description for the portal: "Primary support: Redwood support queues (regionally routed). For SEV1 incidents outside business hours, Redwood on-call is paged. If Redwood on-call is unable to remediate due to capacity or environment constraints, escalation will be routed to AcmeCloud operations per the AcmeCloud-Redwood escalation runbook (link available upon request)."
- We will provide a one-page escalation diagram and a runbook excerpt for the marketplace portal's partner evidence tab.

3) Branding footnote and badge usage
- Footnote (formal): "Service provided by Redwood Inference; marketed and transacted via AcmeCloud marketplace."
- Badge rules: small-size logo must include a link to Redwood trademark terms. No modifications to the Redwood logo allowed; placement must follow the attached brand pdf (page 4). If AcmeCloud needs a co-branded badge, we approve a badge that uses the marketplace seal plus the line: 'Powered by Redwood Inference.'

Attachments we will deliver to you today: 1) Escalation runbook excerpt (one-page PDF), 2) Sample badge files (PNG/SVG), 3) Formal footnote text in marketplace-ready CSV.

Action items: Hannah / Logan to send the runbook excerpt and badge pack to Ravi by EOD. If AcmeCloud can confirm whether the procurement team needs 24x7 contractual SLA, I'll route to our commercial team for pricing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Policy & Listings — Redwood Inference

From: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@acmecloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — support hours, on-call routing & branding footnote

Perfect — this is exactly what we needed.

Next steps from our side: procurement confirmed the portal copy can use the business-hours + 24/7 critical escalation phrasing (no additional SOW needed for the listing). We'll publish with the formal footnote you provided: "Service provided by Redwood Inference; marketed and transacted via AcmeCloud marketplace."

Please send the runbook excerpt and badge pack to marketplace-ops@acmecloud.com and I'll confirm the portal copy this week. Also booking the 11am PT sync — invite sent.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — talk tomorrow.

Best,
Ravi
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, AcmeCloud
